title: subset.receipt@1
description: What `subset` or the Subset manager app installed from the catalog feed, kept at ~/Library/Application Support/Subset/receipts/<bundleId>.json. Advisory only: the installed app's own Info.plist is the truth about what is installed. Closed: an unknown field is invalid.

build.description: The beta build number, present exactly when channel is beta.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the DMG the app was installed from, as listed in the feed.

installedAt.description: A UTC time to the second, such as 2026-11-12T00:00:00Z.

path.description: The installed app: a .app directly inside /Applications or a user's ~/Applications (/Users/<user>/Applications), with no . or .. segment, no hidden app name and no control characters.
